name: mail-webhook
description: Trinity Mail delivery-event receiver: signature-verified webhook handlers for the relay's delivery lifecycle (queued→sent→delivered, deferred, bounced, complained, opened, clicked), an append-only email_events log + status-advancing email_logs, a local suppression mirror with check-before-send, and crypto-shreddable (AES-256-GCM) retained-body storage. Framework-agnostic core with thin Next.js route adapters.
postMessage: Installed to src/mail (pairs with mail-client). 1) Apply webhook/schema.sql to your database. 2) Add the new env keys to your .env: RELAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET (shared with the relay, issued by `trinity-mail init`) and MAIL_BODY_KEY (a 32-byte base64 key — generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`; graduates to the Tresor vault in Phase C). 3) Wire the two route adapters (adapters/next-events-route.ts → app/api/mail/events/route.ts, adapters/next-bounce-route.ts → app/api/mail/bounce/route.ts). 4) Call isSuppressed(recipient) before every send. Tests: `npx vitest run src/mail`.
